title: Crystal Woods Golf Club
specs: 27 holes including an 18-hole championship course and a 9-hole executive course
Craig Woods features an iconic island green on the third hole
Practice facility with grass tees, target greens, chipping area, and putting green
Must be 21 years or older to rent a power cart
Craig Woods cart operators must be at least 25 years old and have a valid driver's license
Appropriate golf attire required: shirts and shoes; metal spikes not permitted
Craig Woods dress code: men must wear sleeved shirts; tank tops and sleeveless shirts not permitted
Hosts golf outings, charity tournaments, leagues, and group events
Group outings can be booked up to one year in advance

blurb: Crystal Woods Golf Club offers 27 holes of golf including an 18-hole championship course and a 9-hole executive course called Craig Woods. The facility includes practice amenities such as a driving range, chipping area, and putting green. Golf outings, charity tournaments, leagues, and group events are hosted throughout the season.
